description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets collected by researchers in different locations over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year”, with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets”, uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>2</sup>, with tick marks at intervals of 10<sup>0</sup>, 10<sup>1</sup>, and 10<sup>2</sup>.  Each year contains a grouped set of bars representing datasets from different researcher locations: “Other” (blue), “USA” (orange), “IN” (green), “IT” (purple), “DE” (brown), and “UK” (red). For example, in 2012, the “Other” bar reaches approximately 2 datasets, while the “USA” bar reaches approximately 1 dataset. In 2022, the “Other” bar reaches approximately 100 datasets, and the “UK” bar reaches approximately 20 datasets. The bars are arranged in groups by year, with each color within a group representing a different researcher location. No bars are visually emphasized, and the groups are sorted chronologically by year.
